title: AC1 - Contact form displays Name, Email, Subject, Message fields

steps.expected: Homepage is loaded

steps.step: Click on 'Contact Us' link or navigate to contact page
steps.expected: Contact form page is displayed

steps.step: Verify contact form contains all required fields
steps.expected: Form displays Name, Email, Subject, and Message input fields

title: AC2 - Required fields show validation errors when empty

steps.expected: Contact form page is displayed

steps.step: Leave all required fields blank (Name, Email, Subject, Message)
steps.expected: All fields are empty
Validation errors appear for each empty required field

title: AC2 - Name field validation error when empty

steps.expected: Contact form page is displayed

steps.step: Leave Name field blank and fill other required fields
steps.expected: Name field is empty, other fields have values
Validation error appears for Name field

title: AC2 - Email field validation error when empty

steps.expected: Contact form page is displayed

steps.step: Leave Email field blank and fill other required fields
steps.expected: Email field is empty, other fields have values
Validation error appears for Email field

title: AC2 - Subject field validation error when empty

steps.expected: Contact form page is displayed

steps.step: Leave Subject field blank and fill other required fields
steps.expected: Subject field is empty, other fields have values
Validation error appears for Subject field

title: AC2 - Message field validation error when empty

steps.expected: Contact form page is displayed

steps.step: Leave Message field blank and fill other required fields
steps.expected: Message field is empty, other fields have values
Validation error appears for Message field

title: AC3 - Successful submission shows confirmation message

steps.expected: Contact form page is displayed

steps.step: Fill all required fields with valid data
steps.expected: All fields (Name, Email, Subject, Message) contain valid values
Form is submitted to backend

steps.step: Verify success confirmation message is displayed
steps.expected: Success message appears confirming form submission

title: AC4 - Invalid email format shows error

steps.expected: Contact form page is displayed

steps.step: Fill all fields with valid data except Email
steps.expected: All fields except Email contain valid values

steps.step: Enter invalid email format (e.g., 'email@test' without domain extension)
steps.expected: Invalid email is entered in Email field
Error message appears indicating invalid email format
Contact form page is displayed

steps.step: Fill all required fields with valid data
steps.expected: All fields contain valid values
Form is submitted to backend

steps.step: Simulate or wait for backend failure
steps.expected: Backend processing fails

steps.step: Verify error message is displayed to user
steps.expected: Backend error message is shown to user
